name: PumpGTM API
description: Run outreach from your own backend or agent: plain REST for sequences, leads, people search, replies and webhooks; X follower eligibility and review-first X Plays; and the Partner API for agencies and platforms that run PumpGTM for many end users from one account (hosted LinkedIn connect links, per-user workspaces, X-Eve-User). The workspace MCP key also authenticates REST. Start at https://pumpgtm.com/docs/api. No browser session required.
